digo_source: Mgombato ('mwatsaka chilly pepper plant (Capsicum frutescens)'; 'Mwatsaka anaawisa mlomoni'); Pakia Table G.2 (varieties)

teaser.en: Digo gardeners name at least six kinds of chilli, from the tiny, fiery *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* to *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.sw: Wakulima wa bustani wa Kidigo hutaja angalau aina sita za pilipili, kuanzia *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe*, ndogo na kali mno, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.
teaser.dg: Akurima a busitani a Chidigo anamanya aina sita za mwatsaka au zaidi, kula *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* mdide na mkali sana, hadi *mwatsaka wa masala*.

summary.en: *Mwatsaka* is the chilli pepper, a small shrub grown in almost every homestead garden. Its hot fruits go into sauces and pickles, onto green mango, and into the sauce of *samaki wa kupaka*.
summary.sw: *Mwatsaka* ni pilipili, kichaka kidogo kinachopandwa karibu katika kila bustani ya nyumbani. Matunda yake makali hutiwa katika michuzi na achari, juu ya embe bichi, na katika mchuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.
summary.dg: *Mwatsaka* (kpwa Chingereza *chilli pepper*) ni mmea mdide unaorimwa karibu busitani zosi za midzini. Matundage makali nkutiywa mtsuzi na achari, nkuriwa na maembe maitsi, na nkutiywa mtsuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.

about.en:
*Mwatsaka* is a small, bushy shrub with glossy leaves and small white star-shaped flowers. The fruits hang or point upwards and ripen from green to red, orange or yellow.

Digo growers distinguish several varieties, including *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (tiny and very hot), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* and *wa vipuli*.
about.sw:
*Mwatsaka* ni kichaka kidogo chenye matawi mengi, majani yanayong'aa na maua madogo meupe yenye umbo la nyota. Matunda huning'inia au huelekea juu, na huiva kutoka kijani kuwa mekundu, ya machungwa au ya manjano.

Wakulima wa Kidigo hutofautisha aina kadhaa, zikiwemo *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (ndogo sana na kali mno), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* na *wa vipuli*.
about.dg:
*Mwatsaka* ni mmea mdide wenye panda nyinji, makodza ganayong'ala na maruwa madide mereru dza nyota. Matundage ganagbwadzika au ganalola dzulu, na ganaivwa kula chijani hadi kundu, rangi ya chungbwa au rangi ya mandano.

Akurima Adigo anatafwautisha aina nyinji, kahi yao *mwatsaka wa chitsawetsawe* (mdide na mkali sana), *ng'ondzi*, *mbuzi*, *manga*, *wa masala* na *wa vipuli*.

where.en: Chilli grows in almost every homestead garden on the south coast, usually a plant or two close to the kitchen.
where.sw: Pilipili huota karibu katika kila bustani ya nyumbani katika pwani ya kusini, kwa kawaida mche mmoja au miwili karibu na jiko.
where.dg: Mwatsaka unamera karibu busitani zosi za midzini pwani ya kusini, kpwa kawaida mmea mmwenga au miiri phephi na dziko.

uses.en: Chillies are used fresh and dried in sauces and pickles, and eaten with green mango and salt. They are also part of the sauce painted onto grilled fish in *samaki wa kupaka*, the signature fish dish of the coast.
uses.sw: Pilipili hutumika zikiwa mbichi au zilizokaushwa katika michuzi na achari, na huliwa pamoja na embe bichi na chumvi. Pia ni sehemu ya mchuzi unaopakwa juu ya samaki wa kuchoma katika *samaki wa kupaka*, mlo maarufu wa samaki wa pwani.
uses.dg: Matunda ga mwatsaka nkuhumirwa mabichi na makavu kpwenye mtsuzi na achari, na nkuriwa na maembe maitsi na munyu. Piya ni seemu ya mtsuzi unaopakpwa ng'onda wa kuochwa kpwenye *samaki wa kupaka*, chakurya cha ng'onda chinachomanyikana zaidi pwani.

culture.en: The name *mwatsaka* is also given to a red variety of maize.
culture.sw: Jina *mwatsaka* pia hupewa aina moja nyekundu ya mahindi.
culture.dg: Dzina *mwatsaka* piya nkuihwa aina ya pemba ya kundu.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwatsaka*. Swahili calls it *pilipili* or *pilipili hoho*. In English it is chilli pepper. Do not confuse it with *mwatsaka wa bara*, a Digo name for jute mallow.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwatsaka*. Kwa Kiswahili inaitwa *pilipili* au *pilipili hoho*. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *chilli pepper*. Usiichanganye na *mwatsaka wa bara*, jina la Kidigo la mrenda.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwatsaka*. Chiswahili chinauiha *pilipili* au *pilipili hoho*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *chilli pepper*. Usiutsanganye na *mwatsaka wa bara*, dzina ra Chidigo ra mrenda (*jute mallow*).

reason.en: Green mango is eaten with chilli and salt
reason.sw: Embe bichi huliwa kwa pilipili na chumvi
reason.dg: Maembe maitsi nkuriwa na mwatsaka na munyu.

reason.en: Jute mallow, which shares part of its name
reason.sw: Mrenda, unaoshiriki sehemu ya jina lake
reason.dg: Mrenda, ambao dzinare ranjina rina neno *mwatsaka*.

reason.en: Maize, one red variety of which is also called mwatsaka
reason.sw: Mahindi, ambayo aina moja nyekundu pia huitwa mwatsaka
reason.dg: Pemba; aina mwenga ya kundu piya inaihwa *mwatsaka*.

reason.en: Turmeric, another spice for samaki wa kupaka
reason.sw: Manjano, kiungo kingine cha samaki wa kupaka
reason.dg: Chikatsu, chitu chanjina chinachotiywa mtsuzi wa *samaki wa kupaka*.
